label: A per se ordered series of efficient…, from Every relatum has finitely many distinct… and 2 more
description: Finite distinct ancestry plus exclusion of every finite causal cycle makes the transitive causal relation a strict order on each finite ancestral set. Mathlib finite-set well-foundedness and the downward-closure accessibility theorem give Acc for every relatum. Explicit inclusion transfers accessibility to the per se relation on the same carrier. This is a mathematical consequence of three unattributed open premises, not an establishment of causal finitism or a source reading, and no root premise is discharged. The omission models respectively retain finiteness with a loop, retain loop exclusion with infinite ascent, and retain both on a causal relation unrelated to a per se loop.
